question: In a certain code language, 'ESTATE' is written as '80', 'FAMOUS' is written as '85', how will 'FOREST' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'ESTATE' is written as '80'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/452d02e52ae3ab2fa664e41b0fb29aaa639e543f3bc611adc4e6f96ca9394dfa.png] 

And,

'FAMOUS' is written as '85'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/41b63b4140880ca3dc34f05943e6d0e40b5bade3275f79ebf27e83dfe6ddbc3a.png] 

Similarly,

'FOREST' is written as

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0791b970ebe86a6730316d24a47fb9481779cb4a200c211a015329ef777ce8a4.png] 

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
